children.value: > Fact From Story The highly anticipated criminal trial for Sam Bankman-Fried, former CEO of bankrupt crypto exchange FTX, started Tuesday to determine whether he’s guilty of seven counts of fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story SBF, as he’s known, has pleaded not-guilty to some seven charges of fraud and conspiracy. | Supporting Fact
> > > Fact From Story The prosecution’s account of the alleged crimes by Bankman-Fried featured a study in contrasts.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A trial involves the prosecution presenting their account of the alleged crimes.
> > Commonsense Knowledge A trial is needed to determine if someone who pleads not guilty is actually guilty. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Commonsense Knowledge Criminal trials are used to determine guilt or innocence.
